usedFor: SuperSaaS takes bookings and viaSocket utilities adds a wait, so “New Appointment” can feed “Pause Workflow”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment” in SuperSaaS, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A new appointment can hold the run for a set number of minutes before the next step carries on.

watchOut: “Appointment Changes” fires on created, changed and deleted appointments, so “Pause Workflow” runs for each.
